answer: Sybil resistance can work through staked identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and reputation flows like a river from verified work rather than wallet count. Fake identities drown in cost, since every duplicate needs fresh collateral, making a sybil fleet as impractical as draining the ocean. Honest peers then cross-attest behavior, and a single bad actor stands out like a nebula against dark sky, slashed and expelled. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
